title: 港府顾问Alan：科技园与北部都会区，如何吸引全球科技企业？
speaker: Alan

segments.en: And even some of the industries we're talking about in technology, especially maybe talking about a 50% tax break, you know, which is a big, big number for most companies.
segments.zh: 甚至我们谈论的一些科技行业，特别是可能50%的税收减免，这对大多数公司来说是一个非常大的数字。

segments.en: And there are a lot of international companies now coming here. You know, we're also talking about universities just specializing in biomedical, which is another big, big health that's very, very important.
segments.zh: 现在有很多国际公司来这里。我们还谈到大学专门从事生物医学，这是另一个非常重要的大健康领域。

segments.en: We've tried with tech parks before, right? I talked about the Science Park and Central Cyberport, you know, in the South Side, which haven't quite materialized.
segments.zh: 我们以前尝试过科技园，对吧？我谈到了科学园和数码港，在南区，这些还没有完全实现。

segments.en: I know, I'm an advisor for the Science Park, and actually it's actually doing very, very well right now.
segments.zh: 我知道，我是科学园的顾问，实际上它现在做得非常好。

segments.en: It's totally come to another level now and expanding as a matter of fact.
segments.zh: 它现在完全达到了另一个水平，事实上还在扩张。

segments.en: So, but there are, we have a lot of interest now from technology companies overseas.
segments.zh: 但是，我们现在有很多来自海外科技公司的兴趣。

segments.en: From the mainland or? Well, mainland and overseas that want to come here now, especially take advantage of the tax break.
segments.zh: 来自内地还是？嗯，内地和海外都想现在来这里，特别是利用税收减免。

segments.en: Also before land prices were so high in Hong Kong, no more.
segments.zh: 另外，以前香港的土地价格很高，现在不再如此。

segments.en: If you're in the North Metropolis, the land prices are very, very low. Government is close one eye and said, okay, in order to get this done by 2030.
segments.zh: 如果你在北部都会区，土地价格非常低。政府睁一只眼闭一只眼说，好吧，为了在2030年前完成这个。

segments.en: We really want to make sure that, you know, we can, and also attract young people, attract engineers, attract different people from tech.
segments.zh: 我们真的想确保我们能够做到，同时吸引年轻人、工程师和科技领域的各种人才。

segments.en: So, you know, and also with the universities now, that's going to be a game changer.
segments.zh: 所以，现在有了大学，这将是一个改变游戏规则的因素。

segments.en: There's so many new universities, the R&D, that really comes out of there.
segments.zh: 有很多新大学，研发真的来自那里。

segments.en: Yeah. I'm very, very bullish for what I see different to, yes, in the past, we have the policy address every year, as every government usually has.
segments.zh: 是的。我非常看好我所看到的与过去的不同，是的，过去我们每年都有施政报告，就像每个政府通常做的那样。

segments.en: Yeah. That's okay. That's the one year thing.
segments.zh: 是的。那没关系。那是一年的事情。
